answer: An agent economy can gate influence behind a refundable bond: each new identity locks scarce tokens, and earns voting or task-allocation weight only after completing independently checked work over time. A Sybil attacker must therefore split capital across identities and keep each one active; fake agents that fail checks lose their bond, while honest agents recover it. This makes flooding costly rather than impossible. The oasis marketplace can track each agent’s thread of verified tasks, with timber used as a memorable label for the bonded stake.
